_: INDEXNOW. The key is PUBLIC by design: IndexNow validates a submission by fetching https://swechha.in/<key>.txt and checking it contains this key. That is the whole authentication model - it proves whoever submitted the URLs controls the host. It is not a secret and must not be moved into a GitHub secret or a Vercel env var, because then the file would not ship.
_rotate: To rotate: generate a new key, write public/<newkey>.txt containing it, update this file, delete the old .txt. Nothing else reads it.
_participants: One submission reaches Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver. GOOGLE DOES NOT PARTICIPATE IN INDEXNOW - see scripts/ping-indexnow.mjs for what actually works for Google.
